diagnosis.original_evidence: At R84 stereo_renderer_r30.cpp the left-eye SetStreamSource failure leaves physical GPU DrawPrimitive uncalled, yet R30TryXyzrhwPrimitiveUP propagated FAILED and DrawPrimitiveUPDestR30 accepted only E_NOTIMPL for original UP fallback.
source_trace: Exact WorldParticle semantic + alpha/depth/stateblock gate selects opt-in DynamicVB path in R30TryXyzrhwPrimitiveUP.
DynamicVB bindEye(0) calls SetStreamSource and may fail before the raw GPU DrawPrimitive call, while R30ExecuteXyzrhwStereo marks incomplete eye and returns a failed HRESULT.
R30DrawPrimitiveUPDestR30 invokes its lower R29/original fallback only when the R30 helper returns E_NOTIMPL.
diagnosis.root_cause: GPU ring submission collapsed the before-draw bind failure and after-draw driver failure into one failed HRESULT, so a safe native-UP fallback was excluded and alpha particles could be absent for a dropped eye.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally retry GPU errors: an already-called driver DrawPrimitive can partially rasterize alpha and replay would double-composite the particle.
Not the HUD D3DX deferred-batch Begin issue: R84 hooks_uiscaling.cpp already preserves a failed reentrant Begin and existing valid batch.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Track physicalDrawAttempted before the raw driver call, permit E_NOTIMPL only if no driver raster attempt occurred and stream restoration succeeded, and keep failure -> mono recovery protections intact.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Compile/run the native portable smoke in Release with -DNDEBUG to verify true fallback and negative no-double-alpha and strict producer gates; HMD and driver-level failure injection remain unperformed.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: The left/right R30ExecuteXyzrhwStereo draw pair owns complete stereo publication, and the existing R29 mono safety suppresses partially drawn right eye after an actual GPU attempt.
